'''Jocal Four''' was a terrestrial astronomical object. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an Imperial [[Unidentified Sith Empire operative|operative]] working undercover on Jocal Four disappeared mysteriously.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Missing Operative}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Missing Operative" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual associated with one of the two rival governments sent a companion of theirs to track down the missing operative. The companion discovered that the operative had faked his [[Death/Legends|death]] to escape Imperial service, so they apprehended him and recovered his mission notes.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jocal Four was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Missing Operative" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
